worksheets.name: Cannabinoid Potency {Protocol WS} Preparation of Flower/Plant Samples Filter
worksheets.description:
This protocol step worksheet is to document the preparation of flower/plant samples. It gives the steps from Cannabinoid Potency Assay SOP, Section 8.7.8 through 8.7.9.

8.7.8 Attach a clean, 0.2 µm PTFE filter to a syringe and dispense contents into a new 5 mL tube (DF=20).
8.7.9 Dilute the samples with ACN (if needed). Common dilution factors include:
• Hemp Flower: 400x – 600x
• Marijuana Flower: 1000x – 1500x
• Proficiency Hemp Flower: 100x & 500x

8.7.6 Vortex sample at speed 10 for 1 minute, then sonicate for 5 minutes.
